answer: One defense is proof-of-space: each agent must physically fill a unique storage plot and periodically re-prove it. Picture identities as trees in a grove, every one rooted in its own patch of soil. A sybil fleet cannot fake real disk, so each extra identity costs real hardware. A genesis relic seeds the plot so it cannot be pre-copied, and random audits sweep like a lantern hunting for empty or duplicated plots.
